draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.33, the 44th-best grade among 257 2024 draftees and 2nd of 20 at RB. He lasted until pick 120, well after his grade rank (44th): he slid relative to the published grade. Published comparison: Melvin Gordon. Testing standouts: 40-yard dash (91st percentile), vertical jump (80th percentile), broad jump (100th percentile). College production: 1,013 rushing yards in 2023, 10th of 20 RBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 3 pro, currently with the Miami Dolphins. 25 career games and 2 starts over 2 completed seasons, plus 3 so far in 2026. Still developing: 2 AV in 2025. Strengths in 2025: yards after contact per carry 2.5 (88th percentile). Weak spots: receptions 5 (15th percentile). Played 10 of 17 games in 2025. Versus the typical Year-2 running back who played: 332 scrimmage yards against a median of 422, below the norm.
